title: Cere Junda
description: Cere Junda had been a Jedi. She also escaped Order 66 and did her best to hide from the Imperial Inquisitors. Cal Kestis was on Bracca when the Second Sister and Ninth Sister found him. Cere an the crew of the Stinger Mantis intervened, saving Cal's life. She became a mentor of the young Jedi.
